sections.heading: How to wear ?
sections.text:
♦ Wear the bracelet on your wrist as a daily accessory to keep its crystal energy close throughout the day.
♦ Set your intention before wearing it, focusing on wealth, confidence, protection, and success energy.
♦ You can wear it during work, meetings, travel, or daily routine for consistent grounding and motivation.
♦ Let the Rice Chain design sit comfortably on your wrist as a style statement while the crystals work energetically.
♦ Avoid contact with water, perfume, sweat, and harsh chemicals to maintain shine and durability.
♦ Store it safely in a dry box when not in use to preserve its premium finish.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Richie Rich Rice Chain Bracelet – 24K Gold Plated

Wealth | Protection | Confidence | Grounding | Success

From the Studd Muffyn Crystal Collection – India’s Biggest Crystal Energy Brand, the Richie Rich Rice Chain Bracelet is thoughtfully designed to combine powerful crystal energy with a bold, aesthetic, and premium everyday style.

This bracelet features a structured rice chain design with a rich 24K gold finish, giving it a clean, polished, and luxurious look on the wrist. Its non-stretchable design, jump rings, and lobster lock closure make it secure, stylish, and easy to wear for daily styling, gifting, or special occasions.

Each crystal is authentic and certified, making this piece more than just an accessory — it is a stylish crystal energy bracelet made for intention and impact.

✨ Crystal Significance

• Pyrite – Money Magnet Crystal
Known for attracting wealth, success, confidence, and positive abundance energy.

• Obsidian – Protection Crystal
Known for grounding, strength, emotional stability, and protection from negativity.

✨ Design Highlights

• 24K gold finish for a premium luxury look.
• Structured rice chain design with bold aesthetic appeal.
• Features 3 Pyrite crystals and 2 Obsidian crystals.
• Handcrafted with authentic and certified crystals.
• Lobster lock closure with jump rings for secure wearing.

Disclaimer: Crystals support your intentions and energy, but real results come when you combine them with hard work, consistency, positive action, and mindful practice. Natural crystals may have slight variations in color, shape, and finish.

It is made with Pyrite Crystal, Obsidian Crystal, and a premium Rice Chain design.

Q2. What is special about Rice Chain?

Rice Chain has a fine textured link design that gives a clean, premium, and elegant look without being bulky.

Q4. What is Obsidian Crystal used for?

Q5. Can I wear this bracelet daily?

Yes, it is designed for comfortable daily wear.

Yes, it is a unisex design suitable for both.
